en.title: I-A-V
en.decryption: The 'Big Three' Rigvedic deities: Indra (War/Rain), Agni (Messenger/Fire), Varuna (Cosmic Order/Rita).

hi.title: I-A-V
hi.decryption: The 'Big Three' Rigvedic deities: Indra (War/Rain), Agni (Messenger/Fire), Varuna (Cosmic Order/Rita).

fact.en: Avoid projecting later Hindu temple culture onto the Rigvedic period; temple worship was non-existent.
fact.hi: Avoid projecting later Hindu temple culture onto the Rigvedic period; temple worship was non-existent.

fact.en: Do not confuse 'Rita' with mere law; it represents the fundamental cosmic order governing the universe.
fact.hi: Do not confuse 'Rita' with mere law; it represents the fundamental cosmic order governing the universe.

fact.en: Rigvedic religion was primarily world-affirming (desiring progeny/cattle), not world-denying (renunciation).
